env_allowlist.HOME: inherited only to locate the hash-verified Elan launcher used by the pinned mathlib environment; Lean subprocesses receive a fixed sandbox environment

network_enforcement: Each Lean subprocess runs under bubblewrap with an unshared network, read-only host root, fixed environment, and one fresh temporary directory as its only writable bind. The outer Python checker performs local file, hash, process, and Git checks only.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line reconciliation summary bound in release-receipt.json

scope_boundary: This bounded worker recipe authenticates the current target and authority inputs, replays the exact statement plus existing partial and conditional bodies at trust zero, and checks a negative release decision. It reuses pinned warm artifacts and cannot master-accept the validation dependency, close the exact root, supply H0/R0 or complete trust/provenance evidence, perform a clean cold offline release build, act as an independent verifier, or grant release/master acceptance.
